title: King Amon and His Death
description: Amon became king after his father Manasseh at the age of 22 and reigned for two years in Jerusalem. He worshiped the idols that his father had made, but he did not humble himself before the Lord as his father had done. His servants conspired against him and killed him in his own house. The people of the land struck down the conspirators and made his son Josiah king in his place.
